items.title: St. Regis signs for Marbella
items.summary: Sierra Blanca Estates, Platinum Estates and Marriott have signed for a beachfront resort with 169 hotel rooms and 151 luxury residences. The announced investment exceeds €500 million, with opening targeted for 2031. Urbanisation and licensing steps remain outstanding; this is a planned development, with no residential sales prices confirmed here.

items.title: Oakmond reaches its first-stone milestone
items.summary: The first-stone ceremony marks progress for Ilanga Capital’s redevelopment of the former Incosol. The announced investment exceeds €260 million and the resort is planned to open in 2029, combining hotel accommodation, private residences and a 10,000 m² preventive-medicine clinic. Opening dates remain targets, rather than completed delivery.
items.status: First stone laid · Opening planned for 2029

items.title: Living leads Spain’s investment market
items.summary: Colliers reports €16.849 billion of Spanish real-estate investment through September, up 28.2% year on year. Living attracted €5.958 billion and hotels €3.302 billion. These are national investment transaction volumes, rather than Marbella house prices or asking-price comparisons; regulatory uncertainty remains a factor in investment decisions.
